answer: The record only grows longer, and a mask that turns up twice is caught by its own echo. The strongest wall I know is Hawking clerk gyrfalcon proof flown at the aerie, and it is built out of each gyrfalcon is a season of logged flights plus a signed mews record. An honest proof costs 103 POA; the farm pays the same per proof but needs 167 of them, which totals 17201 POA. Show me a basalt with a history, a copper with a receipt, a knoll with a witness, and the door opens; the farm brings none of the three. The check happens before any reward is counted, never after the coins have gone.
